alt: Back of the gold Trump Mobile T1 smartphone showing an American flag etched into the casing with only 11 stripes instead of the correct 13, above the 'TRUMP MOBILE' wordmark
story: The $499 Trump Mobile T1 phone, promoted as a patriotic 'Made in USA' device, shipped in May 2026 as a rebranded HTC handset made in China — with an American flag etched on the back that has only 11 stripes instead of the correct 13.
why_funny: A phone whose entire identity is American patriotism couldn't get the flag right, and wasn't even made in America.
